how.title: How it works
how.contract: Token contracts. We read the verified source and the chain: who the owner is (a wallet, a multisig, a timelock or nobody), whether the code can be swapped (a proxy), and every power that's left: minting, blacklists, pausing, tax switches, trading switches. We also simulate a buy and a sell to catch honeypots. An AI reads the code and explains each power, and every point it makes is tied to a line of code or a chain fact.
how.site: Websites. We open the site in a sealed browser with a fake wallet that holds no keys, click its connect and claim buttons, and record everything it asks the wallet to sign: approvals, permits, marketplace orders, transfers. We also check public phishing lists, the domain's age and look-alike names.
how.price: Price. 0.50 USDG, or $0.30 of $FLYAI, on Robinhood Chain. Holders of 200,000 $FLYAI (held or staked) get one free scan a day. A scan that fails gives your payment back for the next one. Reports are public and shareable, and a token or site scanned in the last 24 hours shows for free.
how.limits: Limits. "No red flags found" is not a promise of safety. Scam sites can hide from automated browsers, and a team that holds no special powers can still sell its tokens. Never sign something you don't understand.
